rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for hiring a vehicle exclusively for a period or trip.

example.english: We decided to charter a coach to Sai Kung for a day.
example.traditional: 我哋包租架旅遊巴去西貢一日。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baau1 zou1 gaa3 leoi5 jau4 baa1 heoi3 sai1 gung3 jat1 jat6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose formal term for a document establishing an institution and setting out its principles or powers.

example.english: This charter sets out the institution’s purposes and powers.
example.traditional: 呢份憲章列明咗呢個機構嘅宗旨同權力。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 hin3 zoeng1 lit6 ming4 zo2 ni1 go3 gei1 kau3 ge3 zung1 zi2 tung4 kyun4 lik6

rows.note: Use this for the service or arrangement of hiring a vehicle for your exclusive temporary use.

example.english: For the few days of our trip, we arranged a charter to get around, which was much more convenient.
example.traditional: 去旅行嗰幾日，我哋包車周圍去，方便好多。
example.jyutping: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 go2 gei2 jat6 ngo5 dei6 baau1 ce1 zau1 wai4 heoi3 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a commercial contract to hire a vessel or space on one.

example.english: The shipping company formally handed over the vessel only after signing the charter.
example.traditional: 船公司簽好租船合約之後，先正式交船。
example.jyutping: syun4 gung1 si1 cim1 hou2 zou1 syun4 hap6 joek3 zi1 hau6 sin1 zing3 sik1 gaau1 syun4

rows.note: Use this formal legal phrase when an authority grants or establishes a charter.

example.english: The colonial government used a formal act to charter the university.
example.traditional: 殖民政府正式授予特許狀，成立呢間大學。
example.jyutping: zik6 man4 zing3 fu2 zing3 sik1 sau6 jyu5 dak6 heoi2 zong6 sing4 laap6 ne1 gaan1 daai6 hok6
